text: I've been a patient since their old location, and now they've moved to the new one across from Vachira Phuket Hospital. This place is amazing! The physiotherapists are all so polite, lovely, and provide excellent service. I was experiencing leg pain and couldn't sleep all night. I used electrical therapy to treat my inflamed muscle injury and received a diagnosis from Dr. Elephant (the nickname foreign patients use for him). After my initial treatment, they referred me for a follow-up ultrasound. I feel much better now; the pain is only about 20% gone. I plan to visit again tomorrow when I have time. The new location has convenient parking behind the clinic.

Dr Kitisak and his team seamlessly continued my treatment as I moved to Phuket following a complex break and subsequent long term treatment. They immediately understood the extent of the damage, reviewed my treatment up to that point, and from the start each and every session has been tailored to my rehabilitation as well as my needs that day, including treating other unrelated injuries or issues that ever crop up. The physical massage is expertly reactive to both what I feel and what they can feel in the moment. They seem to have a wide range of equipment, including the ultrasound and electric therapy that I need; facilities and amenities are on par with those I experienced at the private hospital in the city where I moved from. I love the fact I can buy sessions in batches which further help save money on the already reasonable prices, as well as the fact that you don't have to make an appointment and can turn up to suit your schedule. And with long opening hours throughout the week, it is easy to get treatment to fit in with all your daily commitments. Location is easy to find with plenty of parking in the car park behind - you can get a pass from the physio to cover the parking. With excellent English, communication is also very easy. Highly recommended.
The clinic has moved to a new location with convenient parking.

Khun Kitisak got me up and running again every time I crash.
The treatment is painless and you automatically fall asleep.
The girls nurse you well with the ultrasound and the tens are very good and helpful. Not many people can do this treatment and he is an expert in Thailand. There is plenty of parking available and I can highly recommend the treatment.
There is even time for a conversation and a joke and the service is top level.
